description: Underwriting Genie: two Declarative Automation Bundles in one repo. uw-genie-infra: UC schema (hls_fde_dev.uw_genie), volume broker_packages, 2X-Small serverless SQL warehouse, SQL files (DDL, rating function, metric views, tests), notebooks (generate_synthetic_book, upload_packages, reset_demo), jobs setup_demo and reset_demo. uw-genie-agent: the Genie Agent over all tables, metric views and trusted assets (uses the infra schema and warehouse through variables, deploys nothing it does not own). Build 0 (waves 0-0..0-5): two parallel edit waves (infra+agent bundles, then SQL+notebooks), three converge waves (deploy infra + run setup_demo, deploy agent + verify, publish UC skills), one docs wave. Devin monitors at level 4.

genie_space.name: [dev matthew_giglia] Underwriting Genie
probe_questions: What is the Family rate for Northwind Manufacturing at $250K pooling, base trend, requested plan?
What is Northwind credibility at $150K, $250K, and $500K pooling points?
What is Northwind premium change vs current, base case?
Is Northwind v1 submission ready to quote?
How much was removed by pooling at $250K for Northwind?
